Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art animation sprite sheet, extending an existing student character.
Image1 is the ORIGINAL approved back-facing jump atlas. Image2 is the ORIGINAL approved walking atlas. Use ONLY the upright rear-facing student in image1 upper-left cell and the rear-facing walking student in image2 lower two rows as strict identity and rendering references. The new animation must look like the SAME exact sprite, NOT a new illustration.
Preserve the exact jagged/spiky brown hair silhouette and texture, relatively narrow shoulders, original royal blue jacket, narrow dark-navy trouser legs, small dark shoes with pale soles, lime green backpack with same small pale rectangular badge, side pockets and front pouch, identical pixel clusters and upper-left warm light. Do NOT make hair rounder, puffier or larger, do NOT make the torso bulky, do NOT make new outfit details, faces or colors. Match existing pixel art, no smooth anime illustration.
Generate exactly EIGHT sequential frames on a precise 4-column by 2-row landscape 2048x1024 grid. Each 512x512 square cell has one full-body rear-facing student, neutral upright height ~88% of cell, feet centered x50% on y94%, transparent margins. All poses must have IDENTICAL feet/hips/shoulders/backpack positions, identical height and head scale. No ground shadow, floor, captions, grid, scenery or props. True transparent alpha.
This is a very gentle RIGHT-HAND-TO-CHIN preparation animation:
frame0 exact neutral standing rear view matching reference image1 upper-left sprite, both arms down, both feet planted.
frame1 right wrist moves forward by only a few pixels, elbow begins bending very slightly.
frame2 right elbow bends a little more, right hand about lower chest height.
frame3 right hand reaches mid-chest height with modest bent elbow.
frame4 right hand approaches upper chest / collarbone, head remains rear view.
frame5 right forearm rises further, fingertips approaching chin from right; elbow clearly visible to the right of torso.
frame6 right fingertips almost touch chin, head turns ONLY 4 degrees to the right so the gesture is visible from behind.
frame7 final thoughtful pose: right hand lightly at chin, right elbow slightly outward, head rear view with a tiny rightward tilt. Backpack fully visible. No frontal face. LEFT arm remains relaxed by side in ALL frames.
The 8 poses are small evenly spaced incremental changes, not a collection of different poses. Keep all non-moving pixels as consistent as possible; feet and backpack must be fixed. Single hand, NEVER swap hands or lean body. No jump, crouch, walking, waving, large turn, facial reveal, glow or thought bubbles. Detailed consistent GAME SPRITES copied from original character identity.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: eight missing in-between GAME SPRITE frames for an existing rear-view student animation.
Input is the approved eight-frame hand-raise sheet. Your new sheet must COPY the same exact character body, clothes, jagged brown hair, planted shoes, blue jacket, lime backpack, pale badge, pockets, pixel texture, scale and lighting. No redesign. This is ONLY a motion in-between task.
Animate the SMALL GAP between input frame1 (top row column2: right elbow slightly bent, wrist just in front of lower chest) and input frame2 (top row column3: right forearm lifted higher).
Generate 8 evenly spaced in-between poses over that small gap. Frame0 matches input frame1; frame7 matches input frame2. Frames1-6 move right elbow and forearm by tiny equal increments, about2-3 pixels at native sprite size per frame. Most of the right hand stays occluded in FRONT of the chest because the camera is BEHIND the character. This is anatomically correct: draw the elbow outline lifting gradually, don't teleport the hand to the chin. Right elbow bends gradually from about45deg to about95deg, no sudden 90-degree jump. Head stays exactly upright and rear-facing. LEFT arm, both legs, backpack and torso stay IDENTICAL and stationary in all frames. Never swap hands, turn the body, expose a face or grow hair volume.
Exact layout: 4 columns, 2 rows, wide2:1 canvas2048x1024, eight square512cells. One full-body sprite percell, centered feet x50%, baseline y94%, height same as reference. Preserve true transparent background, no floor/shadow/text/grid/props. Crisp polished pixel GAME ART, matching the input last detail. ONLY right elbow/forearm change, tiny gradual movements.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art eight-frame subtle head-look loop.
Image1 is the just-created hand-raise sprite sheet. COPY EXACTLY the character in its LAST cell, row2 column4, as the base for EVERY new frame. Image2 is the original rear student identity. This new sheet must be a matching continuation, not a redesign.
In all eight frames, all pixels below the neck should remain as identical as possible to image1 last-cell body: same right hand touching chin, same bent RIGHT elbow, relaxed LEFT arm, exactly same fixed feet, knees, waist, jacket shape, lime backpack and pale badge/pockets. No hand switch, no arm lowering, no torso rotation, no hair-volume changes. Preserve original jagged brown hair, exact blue/lime/navy palette and crisp pixel detail. Never expose a frontal face or eyes.
Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, landscape 2048x1024, eight equal 512x512 square cells. One full body sprite centered x50%, planted feet y94%, same size as input. TRUE transparent alpha outside character. No floor, shadow, people, buildings, props, labels or grid.
Only the HEAD changes by a few pixels in a restrained seamless look-between-two-universities loop:
0 EXACT last pose of image1: thoughtful rear view, head turned about4 degrees right, right fingertips at chin.
1 head turned only about5 degrees right, tiny motion.
2 head turned about6 degrees right, smallest readable side glance, mostly back of hair and small right ear.
3 head back to5 degrees right.
4 head back to4 degrees right, matching frame0.
5 head near1 degree right (almost straight back).
6 head near1 degree left (almost straight back), right hand ALWAYS at chin.
7 head back to1 degree right, continuing gently to frame0.
Use extremely small gradual changes, no exaggerated angles or body movement. Hair follows same head shape, no extra hair spikes appearing, same character identity, shoulder/backpack/shoe alignment identical. Pixel GAME SPRITES matching the approved original, NOT smooth chibi art. Keep head size constant and chin-hand contact physically plausible.

playback.note: Raise once, then only small rear head glances. Reverse the raise before the next hop. Bridge frames 5–7 are unused because their elbow goes above the final pose.

alignment: Foot centers/baselines and body scale calibrated to the original neutral rear sprite; all other islands retain original animations.
